rationale: The §5.3 main sector list was pre-specified to resolve the v2.1 circularity (non-stationarity cannot both define membership and be the phenomenon investigated). Expanding it after seeing which papers would enter is selection on the outcome, and the same logic that barred deciding membership by the phenomenon bars deciding it by the papers available. Operationally, |B|=42 already commits 40 blind-first papers (35-55 h); adding these would approach the |B|>60 cliff that forces a pause and supervisor decision. Upstream oil & gas was considered on the merits — a gathering centre is continuous-flow and nearer the Sines case than ceramics — and still declined, because 'nearer' is not 'on the registered list'. All are reported as declared exploratory cases outside the main Corpus B, available to the narrative synthesis but absent from every Corpus-B count.
